description: A named CEL `if` that is true, with `then: [x, y]`; `x` is disabled by the profile and `y` reads `{{x.meta.disabled}}`. Proves `value.effects[0]` carries `disabled: true` next to its `index`/`type`/`name`, and that the context rebuild after a disabled branch step exposes the skip node to the next one, the same as a produced value.
